english.title: Cause use of unbraked trailer gross weight not marked

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: ROAD VEHICLES CONSTRUCTION AND USE REGULATIONS 1986

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), caused **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to use on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), an unbraked wheeled trailer which did not have its maximum gross weight plainly marked in a conspicuous place on the outside of the vehicle on its nearside
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 71(2)(b) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 41B of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes:
(i) See regulation 71(1)(d) for exceptions.
(ii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iii) See also offence wordings: H2561 and H3060.
(iv) If the weight was displayed, but in the wrong manner, the place and mode of display should be included in the Statement of Facts.
english.standardstatementoffacts: At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant caused **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to use an unbraked wheeled trailer on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..) when the maximum gross weight of the vehicle was not plainly marked in a conspicuous place on the outside of the vehicle on its nearside .

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
